title: 第5章 盖世圣体第6章 愚蠢
slug: 人在玄幻写日记我真不是曹贼啊
content_zh:
不知为何，第一眼见到楚歌，叶辰就没来由的心生不快。
只感觉眼前之人格外令他不爽。
而接下来场中情况，则令他的这股不爽达到了顶点。
先前展露王体，他受到了许多人的瞩目。
或羡慕，或是嫉恨，或是惊讶，种种目光交织。
其中还夹杂着少女们的崇拜眼神。
叶辰虽自视甚高，看不上这些他眼中的庸脂俗粉，但对于成为众人焦点，却是心中暗爽不已。
在他看来，今日就应该是他出尽风头才是。
王体之资，何其珍稀，未来前途一片广阔，就应该有这般待遇。
却没想到，还未享受多久，便杀出个楚歌。
只是登场，连根骨都还未测试，便将所有人的注意力给吸引了过去。
本还与自己沟通的戒中残魂，在楚歌出现后，也突然没了声音，像是被其所吸引了般。
而那些少女们，更是一个个眼睛都不眨的盯着楚歌看，其中流露出的仰慕之意，连他这尊王体天骄都没有感受过。
特别是有两位少女，叶辰早早便有留意。
这两位少女样貌极为出众，乃是这一批测试弟子中最为拔尖之人。
不仅如此，两女资质也极为不俗，都是极品的灵体根骨！
在他展露出王体之时，两女也只是瞥了一眼，极为淡定，并未如其他人般震惊，想来其出身和见识也不一般。
当然，这都不是最吸引叶辰的地方。两女最为吸引叶辰的点，乃是她们的相貌，有着九成相似！
俨然是一对双生子！
这让他极为中意，甚至想着等测试结束后，与两女交流一番，徐徐图之。

但此刻，他中意的目标，却是将注意力都放到了其他男人身上，这让他心中如何能畅快。
乃至于对楚歌的这股不爽，都逐渐化作了敌意！
好在他虽心中情绪起伏，却也不是无脑之人，知晓此时不是发作的时候。
他还需要在邢风面前，立住自己沉稳谦逊，不骄不躁的少年天骄形象。
“前辈，可有看出这楚歌是什么底细。”他尝试沟通戒指中的残魂存在。
下一刻，一道雌雄难辨的中性声音在叶辰脑海中响起。
“没......不对，这是？”
声音戛然而止，满是愕然。
叶辰还未反应过来，便感觉心神俱震。
下一刻，一股极为庞大的冲击力作用在他身上，令他整个人都倒飞了出去！
他摔倒在地，整个人有些狼狈，又羞又恼的站起来想要知道是谁袭击了自己。
但抬眼便看见，测灵台之上，一道沛然光柱冲霄而起！
只见楚歌一只手放在测灵石之上，身形挺拔如松，面容俊秀如玉，身前的测灵石此刻绽放出璀璨金光，将他衬托的好似天神下凡！
‘这是怎么回事？！’叶辰突然有种不好的预感，这等动静，比之他的王体，还要来的震撼！
“此子........身负圣体！”脑海中，中性的声音再度响起，饱含着莫名的情绪。
“什么？！”叶辰只感觉自己脑瓜子嗡嗡的，差点一个趔趄再度摔在地上。
台上，邢风亦是被突如其来的惊变给吓的不轻，以至于被掀飞出去的叶辰都懒得管了。
“灵柱冲霄........盖世圣体！”
他有些沙哑的说出这句话，浑身的衣袍被楚歌周身掀起的暴风吹的猎猎作响！
这一恐怖动静，不仅令在场之人震惊，更是引起了整个太煌圣地的异动！

那金色光柱直冲云霄，没有人是瞎子，瞬间便注意到了！
“那个地方，好像是测灵台？”
content_en:
For some reason, Ye Chen felt unhappy for no reason when he first saw Chu Ge.
He just felt that the person in front of him was particularly unpleasant.
What happened next on the court brought his unhappiness to its peak.
He had attracted the attention of many people when he showed off his royal body.
Either envy, jealousy, or surprise, all kinds of eyes intertwined.
It was also mixed with the adoring looks of the girls.
Although Ye Chen has a high self-esteem and looks down on these vulgar fans in his eyes, he is secretly happy to be the center of attention.
In his opinion, he should be the one who stole the show today.
The talent of a royal body is so rare, and the future is bright, so it should be treated like this.
But he didn't expect that before he could enjoy it for long, he would be in trouble.
Just appearing on the stage, without even testing his bones, he attracted everyone's attention.
The remnant soul in the ring that was still communicating with him suddenly lost his voice after Chu Ge appeared, as if he was attracted by him.
And those girls were staring at Chu Ge without blinking, and the admiration they revealed was something that even his king-body genius had never felt before.
There were two girls in particular, whom Ye Chen had paid attention to early on.
These two girls have extremely outstanding looks and are the most outstanding among this batch of test disciples.
Not only that, the two women also have extremely good qualifications, and they are both top-notch spiritual bodies!
When he revealed his royal body, the two women only glanced at him. They were extremely calm and were not as shocked as the others. Considering his background and experience, he was not ordinary.
Of course, this is not the most attractive place for Ye Chen. What attracted Ye Chen most to the two women was their appearance, which was 90% similar!
Like a pair of twins!
This pleased him so much that he even thought about communicating with the two women after the test was over to figure it out.
But at this moment, his favorite target was to focus on other men, which made him feel happy.
Even the dissatisfaction with Chu Ge gradually turned into hostility!
Fortunately, although his emotions were ups and downs in his heart, he was not a brainless person and knew that this was not the time to have an attack.
He also needs to establish his image as a young genius who is calm and humble, neither arrogant nor impetuous in front of Xing Feng.
"Senior, have you seen the true nature of this Chu Ge?" He tried to communicate with the existence of the remnant soul in the ring.
The next moment, a neutral voice that was difficult to distinguish between male and female sounded in Ye Chen's mind.
"No...no, this is?"
The voice stopped suddenly, full of astonishment.
Before Ye Chen could react, he felt his mind was shaken.
The next moment, an extremely huge impact force acted on him, causing him to fly backwards!
He fell to the ground, feeling a little embarrassed. He stood up in embarrassment and annoyance, wanting to know who had attacked him.
But when he raised his eyes, he saw a beam of light rising into the sky from the spiritual platform!
Chu Ge was seen placing one hand on the spirit-detecting stone. His figure was as tall as a pine, and his face was as handsome as jade. The spirit-detecting stone in front of him was blooming with bright golden light, making him look like a god descending from heaven!
‘What’s going on? ! ’ Ye Chen suddenly had a bad feeling. This kind of movement was more shocking than his royal body!
"This son...is carrying the Holy Body!" In his mind, the neutral voice sounded again, full of inexplicable emotions.
"What?!" Ye Chen felt his head was buzzing and he almost stumbled and fell to the ground again.
On the stage, Xing Feng was also so frightened by the sudden change that Ye Chen, who was thrown away, didn't even bother to care.
"The spiritual pillar soars into the sky...the unparalleled holy body!"
He said these words hoarsely, and his robes were blown by the storm around Chu Ge!
This terrifying movement not only shocked the people present, but also caused a sudden movement in the entire Taihuang Holy Land!
That golden beam of light shoots straight into the cloudsXiao, no one is blind, they noticed it instantly!
"That place seems to be a spiritual measuring platform?"
